db:info.db:title: Container Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename Key, typename Value> class Container

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: Key is the type used for keys. Value is the type used for values.

db:section.db:title: void Container::insert(Key k, Value v)
db:section.db:para: Inserts key k with value v into the container. The types Key and Value are inherited from the class template.

db:section.db:title: template <typename Other> void Container::merge(Other source)
db:section.db:para: Merges source into this container. The Other type must be compatible with this container's Key and Value types.
